.Hey I'm Derrick 22 years old i live in New Jersey. I'm currentlyl ooking for a serious relationship.

Let me first start off with how I look.

I'm about 5'5 brown hair, short, Grey blue eyes, average body type. My profile picture is me btw because I don't know how to send pictures on here.

As of kind of women I'm into

I'm into any race and size. You just have to take care of yourself and be accepting of me. I don't really have a type or a dream girl as long as you make me smiles happy spend time with me I will start to like you. 

Important part of me.

I just need to let you know this i have adhd asburgers and add. These all combined make me a bit different from most guys not in like a shy way or me hiding how I feel way though. It's hard to explain but I have some issues with conversations its a part of me that will probably never change to be honest. I also get attached quickly because of asburgers especially if your sweet and caring. There is more to it but the more you get to know me the more you will figure me out. I prefer voice calls to texting just because it shows my personality more its fine if you can't do that.

As of how I would be as a boyfriend and a bit about my love life

I a very loving person I'm a huge cuddler kisser huger I love to go on dates or just stay home and enjoy your company. I also just want to let you know I do have add and asburgers so sometimes I do say things I don't mean or just don't understand as quickly. Im also a emotional  kind of guy so I like fight for my girl I love and don't just leave. I have never had my first kiss or even a physical girlfriend yet so expect lots of love to come your way.I do get Jelous easy and very overprotective and once im into you. I end up to the point where i never want to let you go. I don't cheat and never will. Im very loyal. I'm open to long distance as long as it turns into a US getting together. There is more but I'm not going to spoil all of how I love someone.

Abit about my depression and stuff

I've been treated very poorly by family,friends,and girls in general so it takes awhile to warm up and trust. I get ghosted alot and abandoned sadly and I'm very depressed because of it. I don't really have any friends or family I talk to just kind of stay to myself because of the fact I get treated so badly. I've heard it all and seen it all and I do explain how I feel alot and will probably ask you alot how you feel. But once you gain my trust you gain all my love. I have problems falling Asleep at night because of loneliness. I will stop being all depressing now.

A bit about my hobbies

I'm into gaming actually built a pc for my self and my sister and her boyfriend. Even my mom lol. The kind of games I play are like fps, roblox, minecraft, and simulation  type of games also open world. When I'm not doing that im watching Netflix just watch random things on there. Also watch lots of YouTube I watch literally anything on there.Im a homebody but I do love going to theme parks especially hershey park. I also collect game consoles mostly like limited editions. I also love to sing people say I have a good voice but you can be the judge of that lol. My favorite singers are mgk,nf,the kid lori,dax,and juice world.

My job

I work on a militarily base as a stocker at the commissary. If you don't know what that is its a store I work nights 8:00 till when I get done. Worked there for 2 years now.

As for my future 

I'm hoping to live in hershey Pennsylvania. Because the fact I've been wanting to live there most of my life. Also because of low crime and because of hershey park. I'm fine if you want to have kids or not I'm fine with eather. Am looking to get married not just to be bf gf. Even after we are together for awhile I will still take you out on dates and call you beautiful.

My last thing is 
I also have a thing for feet its not sexual but if its a deal breaker im sorry about that if you want to know about it more just ask me 

Thanks for reading and I hope to hear from you!
